errors.evidence: The chart shows grouped horizontal bars, not stacked bars. For each category, the three bars representing the different sectors are placed next to each other, not on top of each other to form a single stacked bar.

errors.text_span: in absteigender Reihenfolge der Gesamtanteile sortiert
errors.evidence: The chart consists of grouped, not stacked bars, so 'Gesamtanteile' (total shares) are not visually represented. While the categories are sorted by the general magnitude of their values, stating that the sorting is specifically based on the sum of the shares is an unsubstantiated interpretation.
